protocol.cache_policy: Both measured executors recompute semantic admission/expanded/replacement summaries per record without a semantic-result cache. Both share normalized class grouping for 20 representative reports. The common independently authored readback checker memoizes completion queries identically after execution. OS page caches are shared and warm; no cold-I/O claims.
protocol.comparison: Require identical replacement stream digest and affected-ID digest; compare semantic proof obligations and independent verifier success rather than force one literal witness enumeration order. Five same-host pairs give descriptive medians/ranges and paired differences, not population inference.
equivalent_obligations: Read/hash/group all 50,931 actual retained receipts, validating schema and old catalog/domain/snapshot binding.
Read/hash/index the complete 251,734-case source derivative inside the timer.
Produce 20 literal representative reports with old admission, new status, one witness per possible new label and every inclusion-minimal robust field set.
Produce exactly 33,489 affected receipt IDs with class mapping and P obligation.

Individually check all 50,931 old receipts; acquire P only on ambiguity, validate each source envelope against the current request, then separately check each replacement's binding/literals/sufficiency.

Serialize the same complete per-record repair ledger and replacement receipts, gzip, flush/fsync, reopen payloads, verify portable reports and independently reconstruct every ID, response, and replacement.
protocol.host_isolation: Single-CPU affinity is not exclusive-core or exclusive-host isolation. Unrelated user pytest/LibreOffice processes were observed before measurement; they are not controlled or stopped. Our paper builds and ERP build/tests pause during all measurements. Host load and CPU0 counters/process names are recorded before/after every child. Report both CPU and wall time and descriptive alternating-pair ranges; do not claim a quiet, dedicated host or infer a portable speedup.
protocol.implementation_boundary: OrdinaryWorkflow separately implements JSON-rule enumeration, minimal distinguishing field sets, report assembly and P-first worklist repair. It does not invoke ReceiptRepair, raw_summary, diagnostic engines or make_bundle. Both share the receipt parser/content hash, public source envelope adapter, artifact persistence, and external verification. Normalized direct enumeration avoids materializing/parsing raw witnesses during every per-record diagnosis. Thus differences are complete implementation costs, not isolated algorithm speedup or unique capability.

measurement_boundaries.clock: perf_counter_ns wall and process_time_ns CPU for each nonoverlapping phase and actual integrated total. Phase medians need not sum to median total. Python imports, protocol parsing and independent-checker imports precede total and are separately reported; child subprocess wall includes startup.
measurement_boundaries.freeze: Protocol, script, tests and all dependency/input hashes captured before any warmup/measured child. Changes require new output directory and retained previous evidence.
measurement_boundaries.included: Retained archive hashing/read/parsing, schema/binding validation and class grouping; full source hash/read/index; representative admission/diagnosis, literal witnesses and robust obligations; full exact-ID construction; unchanged checked per-receipt P-first repair API; gzip ledger encoding; artifact JSON/gzip serialization; file flush/fsync and directory fsync; reopened-file checksums, portable report verification, independent ID/response/replacement semantic verification.
measurement_boundaries.limits: Five rounds are descriptive same-host medians/ranges. Existing strict transition and public cohort are regression data, not a new industrial deployment. No cross-service speedup or user/productivity claim; no actual authorization service, remote I/O, concurrent production load or transactional rollback measured.
measurement_boundaries.memory: Linux ru_maxrss after each phase and at end is absolute child-process high-water KiB, not incremental method allocation.
measurement_boundaries.persistence: Creates new output files, flushes and fsyncs each, then fsyncs the output directory and its parent. Immediately reopens and verifies persisted bytes. OS page caches are not flushed; no cold-cache latency, actual storage power-loss durability, network or authentication measurement.
measurement_boundaries.shared_classes: 20 representative reports cover normalized observation classes, with exact case-to-class mapping independently rebuilt. Reports preserve exemplar literals; this is not 50,931 separately serialized witness reports.
measurement_boundaries.source_setup: Hashes and indexes all 251,734 public-derived source cases inside the integrated timer. Subsequent 33,489 profile acquisitions are logical reads from this memory index, not physical source I/O reductions. Caller-supplied local public-source capabilities authorize P/T.
measurement_boundaries.verification: Portable verifier plus existing separate stdlib declarative predicates/completion reconstruction checks 20 class witness reports, independently reconstructs all exact IDs and old admission, reconciles each acquired response with source and current request, and checks all 50,931 replacement fibers/literals/raw source decisions.

protocol.ordering: One excluded pair ordinary then checked; five measured pairs alternate checked/ordinary then ordinary/checked. Each executor runs in a fresh process on CPU 0. No timing exclusion or stopping based on outcomes.
protocol.profiling_scope: Separate full-cohort cProfile and recovery-part instrumentation, excluded from the uninstrumented paired sample. Components include full execute, row checks/JSON encoding and gzip writing; profiler overhead is not corrected and no comparison ratio is inferred from instrumented times.
protocol.purpose: Equal-obligation full native strict-change workflow comparison, conventional worklist implementation versus unchanged checked API composition; no speedwin assumption.
protocol.scaling_scope: Controlled native-ID subsets with no invented or repeated records. N=1,000/10,000 and full N=50,931 all retain K=20 classes by forcing one native exemplar per class before source-order filling. K=1/5/10 at N=1,000 uses classes in descending native frequency and includes each exemplar; K=20 is the n:1000 cell. The full retained archive and source index are still read in every cell, deliberately retaining fixed setup cost. Changing K also changes class complexity/repair prevalence; report composition and do not attribute time solely to K. Three measured fresh pairs per subset, with warm OS caches following the full-cohort benchmark; not extrapolation beyond 20 native classes.
protocol.scope: Only the existing strict target and retained public cohort; no claim of full industrial deployment, alternative-target performance, remote access savings, user productivity, transactional rollback, authenticated source or power-loss durability.
protocol.selection: All 50,931 receipts in source order, no sampling; classes rebuilt from actual receipts with no saved diagnostics or ID mapping. All 20 normalized observation classes receive one literal representative report. Every receipt receives a checked replacement.
